Vanta was able to display up to 1920 x 1200 in 32-bit colour depths at a 72 Hz refresh rate. The second model was the top-performing TNT2 Ultra , which came with a 150 MHz core clock and 183 MHz memory clock (2.9 GB/sec). This pushed its 3D processing throughput up to 300 MPixel/sec - a 20% improvement over the standard TNT2 and a 50% improvement over the TNT. <p
